requirements.quote:
Definition: Local system automatically starts the BGP peer
                     connection with peer oscillation damping enabled
                     and PassiveTcpEstablishment enabled.  The exact
                     method of damping persistent peer oscillations is
                     determined by the implementation and is outside the
                     scope of this document.
requirements.condition: If the local system supports and generates optional Event 7, AutomaticStart_with_DampPeerOscillations_and_PassiveTcpEstablishment
requirements.required_behavior: Automatically start the BGP peer connection.
requirements.why_checkable: The Event 7 trigger can be checked against automatic connection start behavior.

requirements.quote:
Definition: Local system automatically starts the BGP peer
                     connection with peer oscillation damping enabled
                     and PassiveTcpEstablishment enabled.  The exact
                     method of damping persistent peer oscillations is
                     determined by the implementation and is outside the
                     scope of this document.
requirements.condition: If the local system supports and generates optional Event 7, AutomaticStart_with_DampPeerOscillations_and_PassiveTcpEstablishment
requirements.required_behavior: Enable peer oscillation damping for the automatic connection start; the exact damping method is implementation-defined.
requirements.why_checkable: The Event 7 path can be checked for enabled damping state without prescribing its algorithm.

requirements.quote:
Definition: Local system automatically starts the BGP peer
                     connection with peer oscillation damping enabled
                     and PassiveTcpEstablishment enabled.  The exact
                     method of damping persistent peer oscillations is
                     determined by the implementation and is outside the
                     scope of this document.
requirements.condition: If the local system supports and generates optional Event 7, AutomaticStart_with_DampPeerOscillations_and_PassiveTcpEstablishment
requirements.required_behavior: Enable PassiveTcpEstablishment for the automatic connection start.
requirements.why_checkable: The Event 7 path can be checked for passive TCP establishment state.

requirements.quote:
Status:     1) The AllowAutomaticStart attribute SHOULD be set
                        to TRUE.
requirements.condition: If the local system supports and generates optional Event 7, AutomaticStart_with_DampPeerOscillations_and_PassiveTcpEstablishment
requirements.required_behavior: The AllowAutomaticStart attribute SHOULD be set to TRUE.
requirements.why_checkable: The optional attribute value associated with Event 7 is observable.

requirements.quote:
2) The DampPeerOscillations attribute SHOULD be set
                        to TRUE.
requirements.condition: If the local system supports and generates optional Event 7, AutomaticStart_with_DampPeerOscillations_and_PassiveTcpEstablishment
requirements.required_behavior: The DampPeerOscillations attribute SHOULD be set to TRUE.
requirements.why_checkable: The optional damping attribute value associated with Event 7 is observable.

requirements.quote:
3) The PassiveTcpEstablishment attribute SHOULD be
                        set to TRUE.
requirements.condition: If the local system supports and generates optional Event 7, AutomaticStart_with_DampPeerOscillations_and_PassiveTcpEstablishment
requirements.required_behavior: The PassiveTcpEstablishment attribute SHOULD be set to TRUE.
requirements.why_checkable: The optional passive TCP attribute value associated with Event 7 is observable.

requirements.quote:
Definition: Local system automatically stops the BGP
                     connection.
requirements.condition: If the local system supports and generates optional Event 8, AutomaticStop
requirements.why_checkable: The AutomaticStop event can be checked against connection stop behavior.

requirements.quote:
